content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-124. - Sewer districts and subdistricts.
content.summary:
The city may establish and maintain separate or combined sewer systems, which systems
               shall be divided into district and subdistrict sewers for storm drainage, sanitary
               drainage or both, upon initiation by the council.
(Code 1981, § 27-124; Ord. No. 551, § 65, 5-14-1964…
